title: Design validity, residualisation and generalisation in donor-level single-cell classifiers
description: Code, restored donor metadata, locked predictions, source tables, figures and manuscript assets for a two-cohort audit of design-label entanglement in donor-level single-cell classifiers. The release compares frozen Geneformer donor means with expression pseudobulk under repeated donor-level evaluation, design-only prediction, representation-to-design recovery, fold-contained residualisation, matched design restriction, strict source-only transfer and learned pooling.
